description:
Description 

Are you passionate about building and maintaining reliable IT infrastructure? Join our team to support the core systems that power our operations. From servers and storage to virtualization and networking, you’ll ensure everything runs securely and efficiently. You’ll work with modern tools and technologies in a collaborative environment that values automation, performance, and resilience. If you're driven by infrastructure excellence and enjoy solving complex technical challenges, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities: 

  • Maintain and troubleshoot enterprise storage systems and protocols (SAN/NAS) 
  • Administer virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware vSphere) and manage VMs 
  • Perform physical server maintenance, including hardware diagnostics and racking 
  • Manage Windows and Linux servers, including package and service configuration 
  • Support backup and recovery operations across physical and virtual environments 
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) 
  • Monitor system performance and proactively address infrastructure issues 
  • Collaborate with vendors for hardware and support coordination 
  • Document system configurations, processes, and network topologies 
  • Participate in on-call rotation and adhere to change management processes 

 

Requirements: 

Identity & Directory Services 

  • Proficiency in administering Microsoft Active Directory, including user and group management, Group Policy Objects (GPO), Organizational Unit (OU) structure, FSMO roles, and trust relationships 
  • Experience managing DNS and DHCP server roles in Windows Server environments, including zone configuration, record management, and troubleshooting resolution issues 
  • Familiarity with PKI and certificate lifecycle management, including internal Certificate Authority (ADCS), certificate issuance, renewal, and revocation 
  • Experience integrating services with LDAP/Active Directory (e.g., authentication for third-party applications, RADIUS-based network access control, or SSO solutions) 

Microsoft 365 Administration 

  • Experience administering Microsoft 365 tenant, including user provisioning, licensing management, and role-based access control via the M365 Admin Center 
  • Proficiency in managing Exchange Online, including mailbox management, mail flow rules, anti-spam/anti-phishing policies, shared mailboxes, and distribution groups 
  • Familiarity with Azure Active Directory (Entra ID) and hybrid identity scenarios, including Azure AD Connect synchronization, Conditional Access policies, and MFA enforcement 
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 security and compliance features (Defender for Business, Purview basics, DLP policies) is a plus 
  • Working knowledge of SharePoint Online and OneDrive administration for storage quota management and permissions governance 

Atlassian Suite Administration 

  • Experience administering Jira (Software and/or Service Management), including project configuration, workflow customization, permission schemes, and user management 
  • Ability to manage Confluence spaces, page permissions, and templates to support technical documentation and knowledge base maintenance 
  • Familiarity with Bitbucket repository administration, including repository access control, branch permissions, and integration with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Bamboo or Jenkins) 
  • Experience managing Atlassian user directories, including LDAP/Active Directory integration for centralized authentication and group synchronization 
  • Understanding of Atlassian Data Center or Cloud deployment models and licensing considerations is a plus 

Storage Administration: 

  • Experience in maintaining, updating, and troubleshooting enterprise-grade storage systems (e.g., NetApp, Lenovo), including SAN/NAS protocols (NFS, SMB, iSCSI, Fibre Channel). 
  • Knowledge of storage provisioning, replication, and performance tuning. 

Physical Server Management: 

  • Proficiency in maintaining physical servers, including hardware diagnostics, component replacement (e.g. hard drives, RAM etc.), cabling, and general upkeep (e.g. Firmware/BIOS/RAID/HBA/NIC updates) 
  • Experience coordinating with support vendors and suppliers for hardware issues, parts, and warranty claims. 
  • Familiarity with server racking, stacking, and power/cooling considerations within a data center environment. 
  • Out-of-Band Management (OOBM - iLO, iDRAC or IPMI 

Virtualization Systems: 

  • In-depth administrative experience with Virtualization Systems (e.g. VMware vSphere ESXi, vCenter Server), including configuration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. 
  • Ability to manage and provision virtual machines (VMs) across various operating systems. 

Operating Systems: 

  • Windows server administration skills (various versions). 
  • Linux server administration skills (Ubuntu/Debian preferred) - package management, service configuration, and command-line operations. 

Backup System Administration: 

  • Experience in managing backup solutions for both physical servers and virtual machines (VinChin backup solutions is highly preferred). 
  • Familiarity with various backup strategies (full, incremental, differential) and recovery procedures. 
  • Regular backup restore testing. 

Scripting: 

  • Ability to write scripts for basic system administration tasks and automation (PowerShell/Bash/Python, or similar). 
  • Experience with scripting for integration between different systems, e.g., Bamboo and Active Directory. 

Miscellaneous: 

  • Experience deploying and administering Wazuh (as SIEM platform), integrating with external systems, maintain and upgrade Wazuh components, manage index retention policies, and ensure platform availability 
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure issues. 
  • Ability to create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including network diagrams, system configurations, and operational procedures. 
  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools to proactively identify and address potential issues (Zabbix, Prometheus+Grafana) 
  • Understanding of IT security principles and best practices as they apply to servers, networks, and data centers. 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for interacting with team members, vendors, and other stakeholders. 
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team. 
  • Willingness to participate in on-call rotations for critical system support. 
  • Adherence to change management processes and procedures. 

Would be a significant plus 

  • Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and tools, e.g.: 
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform 
  • Configuration Management: Ansible 
  • Version Control: Git 
  • CI/CD Pipelines: Jenkins 
  • GitOps: ArgoCD 
  • Logging & Monitoring: ELK Stack 
  • Public Clouds: any major provider (AWS/GCP/Azure) 
  • Containerization: Docker & Kubernetes 
  • Networking knowledge: 
  • Understanding of networking concepts 
  • Experience in configuring and troubleshooting switches, routers, and firewalls (Cisco ASA, Fortigate) - routing protocols, VLANs, ACLs, site-to-site VPNs and SSL VPNs 

 PLEASE NOTE THAT THIS IS A FULLY ON-SITE POSITION.

Address: Swan Offices, Sos. Bucuresti Nord, nr. 15-25, Windsor Royal building.
